author: /root
scope: Seven existing leaves across five Hyunsu and anniversary roots × JA/CN/TW = 21 corrections.

review.method: Compared the seven Korean leaves and 21 accepted targets with complete choices, deferred receipt echo, passed/pivoted photo context and 24/36-month consumers.
review.findings: Next-week departure stays distinct from the next day's lack of an exam. The repeated question and answer, single lid rattle, phone light, coworker versus county-office photos, 24 months, eight minutes and three years remain distinct. JA1/CN2/TW3 draft changes only preserve/clarify the documented semantics, number forms and repeated wording.

preservation.proof: Three canonical receipts and actual targets match final responses. Exact reversal restores nine overlays and complete prior ledger, including previous target hashes and superseded acceptances.

validation: Pure check_batch and final check2/accepted-import VALID with empty stderr. Initial JA numeric/sign and CN/TW occurrence rejections remain historical. No engine.

identity.encoding: Raw canonical JSON basename-sorted [basename,bytes,sha256]; rows [locale,id,source-hash,previous-target-hash,target-hash] in export order.
